articles.summary: In conjunction with upcoming investor meetings, Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBRA) has issued a business update, which is available on the company’s website. In addition, Rick Matros, the company’s Chair and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Costa, the company’s Chief Financial Officer, Darrin Smith, the company’s Chief Investment Officer, and Lukas Hartwich, the company’s Executive Vice President of Finance, will participate in the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference September 15 – 17, 2026 at the Bank of America Tower in New York, New York. About Sabra Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. , a Maryland corporation, operates as a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust (a “REIT”) that, through its subsidiaries, owns and invests in real estate serving the healthcare industry throughout the United States and Canada. Investor Media Inquiries: 1-888-393-8248 or investorinquiries@sabrahealth.com Source: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc.
articles.title: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc., Issues Business Update and will Participate in the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference
